hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The first subarray must start at index 0, so nums[0] is always part of the cost.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: The remaining two subarrays can start at any two distinct indices between 1 and n - 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: To minimize the sum, select the two smallest numbers in nums[1:].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting suffix of length n - 1 to extract two smallest values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs takes O(n^2) time whereas two minimums can be found in O(n) or O(n log n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list space for suffix elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that first partition index is fixed at 0.
